descriptionPlain:
About the Role
We're seeking a strategic Director/Senior Director of Revenue Operations to own the systems, productivity, and analytics that power our revenue organization across the full customer lifecycle — from initial outreach through renewal. This role sits at the center of revenue execution, with end-to-end visibility into every stage of the funnel: prospecting and outreach, pipeline and conversion, close, onboarding, and renewal/expansion.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Inside/Outside Sales, Finance, Energy Markets, and our Customer Organization to ensure alignment across the revenue lifecycle, translating revenue strategy into operational execution — owning forecasting, pipeline management, go-to-market efficiency, and customer growth. Critically, you'll be the person who connects the dots across the funnel: surfacing risks, opportunities, and performance trends as they emerge at any stage, and elevating the right insights and recommended actions to leadership. Because a signed contract at Voltus is just the start of revenue generation, not the end of it — value depends on enrolled assets actually performing in market events — this role also owns the forecasting and reporting that connects committed contract value to realized, performance-based revenue.

lists.content:
Full Lifecycle Ownership

  • Own end-to-end visibility across the full customer lifecycle funnel — initial outreach, pipeline progression, close, onboarding, and renewal — ensuring data, process, and reporting connect seamlessly across each stage

  • Build the reporting and analytics infrastructure to flag leading indicators of risk or opportunity at any point in the journey and route them to the right owner in real time

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, and the Customer Org so handoffs (lead → pipeline → customer → renewal) are governed by consistent data and process, not disconnected systems

  • Design and own a customer health score — combining enrollment status, market-event performance, engagement, and support signals — that flags at-risk customers early and gives Sales, Customer Success, and Energy Markets a shared, actionable view for coordinated intervention

  • Regularly synthesize cross-funnel insights into clear, action-oriented recommendations for sales and executive leadership

  • Own forecasting and reporting that tracks contracted value through enrollment, market participation, and dispatch performance to realized revenue — partnering with Energy Markets and Finance to reconcile committed vs. realized revenue and flag performance risk before it hits the P&L 

    • Team Leadership

  • Manage and develop a team spanning sales productivity, analytics, and operations — mentoring managers within the function

    • Forecasting & Analytics

  • Own accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline analytics across the full funnel, including renewal/retention forecasting in partnership with the Customer Org and Finance; present findings directly to sales and executive leadership

    • Planning Infrastructure

  • Build planning infrastructure for scale: Sales and Customer Success headcount modeling, territory design, capacity planning, quota setting/allocation, and potential quota/comp redesign across segments — in partnership with Sales and Customer leadership — as new markets and segments come online

    • Systems & Tooling

  • Lead the cross-functional GTM systems roadmap (CRM, forecasting, and business intelligence platforms) spanning outreach through renewal tooling, in partnership with IT/Systems teams

  • Partner with Inside Sales, Outside Sales, Customer Success, and training to align tooling and process changes with rep productivity goals

    • Process & Standardization

  • Drive standardization of GTM processes across the full customer journey, from prospecting through renewal

  • Define and track core RevOps KPIs across the funnel (win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time, pipeline coverage, renewal, expansion rate)

  • Own CRM pipeline hygiene — stage definitions, probability methodology, and data-quality standards — and hold the team accountable to consistent, trustworthy pipeline data leadership can act on

• 7+ years in revenue operations, with 3-5 years manager/director level or above – has owned the function, not just supported it

  • Track record partnering cross-functionally across the customer lifecycle

  • Advanced proficiency with CRM administration and business intelligence tools (Salesforce, Tableau, Gong, Outreach, etc.)

  • Experience building forecasting models and comp plans at scale

  • Experience connecting funnel-stage data (outreach, pipeline, renewal) into a unified reporting view, including revenue that is realized post-close through usage-, performance-, or event-based models

  • Energy, utilities, or complex B2B background strongly preferred — comfortable with deal cycles and revenue recognition driven by external market timing, program windows, and regulatory context

salaryDescription: Base pay is $170,000-$196,000 annually, commensurate with experience, with a 10-15% bonus paid annually, and equity. In addition to a competitive compensation package, Voltus offers a range of benefits including: unlimited leave for full-time employees, parental leave, and a comprehensive benefits package to promote health, wellness, and financial security.
